# Trace fixtures

Labelled sample traces for the stroke matcher (core `lib/strokes/trace.ts`), one file per character
(named by code point): 20 kana and 20 kanji. Generated by `npx tsx scripts/make-trace-fixtures.ts` from KanjiVG
medians with seeded jitter, **not recorded by hand**. Add traces recorded on phones and tablets (as `samples`
with the same shape) before tuning the thresholds further.
